narrative.overview: A lacquered near-black table with a felt well, brass-tinted hairlines and bone-white type. Cash is chips, players are chips, deeds are playing cards. Surfaces are flat fills with 1px rules and 6px corners; depth comes from tone and from inset felt, not from glows. It is an operating tool for a live game: at a glance a player knows whose turn it is, the deadline, what just happened, and the one gold button they can press.
keyCharacteristics: One filled gold action per view; everything else is outline, secondary or ghost.
Chips are the recurring object: pawns, cash flights, bid tokens.
Felt green is the table and success; ruby is rent, danger and urgency.
Limelight is a rare display voice; Hanken Grotesk does all the work, with tabular numerals.
Flat fills, 1px rules, no neon glow, no glass, no gradient text.

rules.name: The One Gold Button Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only filled action colour and appears as one primary per view. Cash figures, tags and labels stay bone.

rules.name: The Felt Is The Table Rule
rules.body: Green means the table or a gain; red means rent, loss or danger. Do not use either as decoration.

rules.name: The Colour Is Never Alone Rule
rules.body: Players are told apart by the initial on their chip, not by colour.

rules.name: The Marquee Rule
rules.body: Limelight appears only for the wordmark and the three screen titles. Nothing else gets the display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every dollar figure is tabular and goes through Money where it can change.

rules.name: The Flat Until Physical Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a shadow only if it is an object on the table (chip, die, modal), never a card or panel.

dos: Do keep exactly one gold filled button per view and make it the next legal action.
Do show money moving: use Money and ChipFlights for every cash change.
Do pair colour with the player's initial or a label.
Do keep type sentence case, tabular numerals for money, and Limelight to the three titles and the wordmark.
Do use 1px rules at #2A313C and 6px corners; shadow only physical objects.
Do read the product name from src/lib/brand.ts.
donts: Don't add neon glow, glass cards, gradient text or emoji icons.
Don't use ruby or felt as decoration; they carry meaning.
Don't use uppercase eyebrows or kickers above titles.
Don't set cash figures or tags in gold.
Don't introduce a second filled accent button style.
